description: The reception window allows each later transmission one block and 1.5 s of host latency, so a transmit_done that comes late does not make the sender drop the copies still owed.
note: As dts-nonarq/segments-across-transmissions ("segment-me-now", priority 0, TTL 0, no retransmissions; dts.max_segment_size 8 cuts the 20-byte C_PDU into 8, 8 and 4 bytes, C_PDU ID 0; one 63-byte block per transmission, so segment 0 goes first and segments 1 and 2 wait, C-0880, C-0542) with csma.cont_slot_width_ms 1, so the contention allowance in the window is 1 ms and leaves no slack (the contention wait is 0 with one slot, K-0080). Reception window (C-1051, interp C-1292, corpus 0.37.0, P7-9 round 4, issue #38): with n later transmissions owed, window = ceil((duration - block start + n x X) / 500), X = min(127500, dts.max_transmission_ms) + lbt_wait_vdcd_ms + num_cont_slots x cont_slot_width_ms + one block of the waveform in use + the 1500 ms host allowance = 5550 + 3000 + 1 + 4800 + 1500 = 14851. First transmission at 30000 (5550 ms, the D_PDU in block 0 from 600): n = 1, window ceil((4950 + 14851) / 500) = 40, committing to 30000 + 600 + 20000 = 50600 (C-1052). The host reports transmit_done 1300 ms after the planned end, at 36850 (the host latency measured on 30 s bursts, docs/stack-sweep.md of M0LTE.S5066); the LBT wait after an own transmission, 3000 (K-0074), runs from it, so LINKING comes at 39850. A transmission starting then lasts at most 600 + 4800 + 150 = 5550 and ends by 45400, inside 50600, so segments 1 and 2 go (offsets 8 and 16, EOT and window 10, C-0350), and dts.ttd is cancelled first because that empties the queue (C-1050). Without the allowance (corpus 0.36.0) X was 8551, the window ceil(13501 / 500) = 28 committed to 44600, and 45400 is past it: both segments would have been dropped with no transmission (C-0353, C-1052).
